Last night I saw the future of the UK Muslim startup scene.

As part of team Deen Developers and a batch member in their buildathon, I’m proud to witness and contribute to what we’re building. We’re at such an exciting time in the UK Muslim tech scene, and it’s incredible to watch this community grow from infancy. Seeing founders with both talent and integrity working to make a difference is what makes this movement truly unique.

Yes, there’s talk about how far behind we are compared to places like SF, but today showed just how optimistic we can be about bridging that gap. One of the founders did the opening recitation, setting the tone. We saw projects ranging from Quran and seerah apps to sadaqah platforms—all built with a deep grounding in faith.

And by the way, I’m working on something special too, a project called Bilal—but that’s a story for another post.

I’m grateful to be part of this moment and to support as many Muslim startups as possible. Let’s keep building, keep growing, and keep giving back, insha’Allah.

Shout out to the incredible team at DD Ibrahim Javed Muntasir Syed Taz Latif Ibraheem R. just to name a few!

Shout out to our roasters who came to support as always as they have since the beginning Shahzad Younas Ibrahim Khan Humayra Hanif

And shout out to the batch members, that we’ve seen grow and develop throughout the programme Kaazim Zia Sadiq Dorasat Hamada Mahdi Dilwoar Hussain

There’s so many more deserving of shoutouts apologies for missing people, they know who they are.

Everyone really came together to make this possible.

The future is bright inshaAllah.
